overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Mid-Cap Value ETF (VOE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Mid Cap Value TR USD index. The fund tracks an index of mid-cap stocks in the US. Holdings are selected and weighed based on five value factors. VOE was launched on Aug 17, 2006 and is issued by Vanguard.
